new.title: New campaign: {campaign}
new.body: Claim it before the slots or budget run out.

invited.title: You are invited to campaign {campaign}
invited.body: Open the campaign to read the brief and claim a slot.

approved.title: Campaign {campaign} approved
approved.body: The campaign passed review and goes live on schedule.

rejected.title: Campaign {campaign} rejected
rejected.body: Fix the campaign and submit it again.

live.title: Campaign {campaign} is live
live.body: Clippers can now claim it. Track views and budget from the dashboard.

settled.title: Campaign {campaign} finished
settled.body: The final report is ready. Remaining budget follows your refund or rollover choice.

expiring.title: Your claim is about to expire
expiring.body: Your claim on {campaign} ends {expiresAt}. Post and submit before the slot is released.

approved.title: Your submission was approved
approved.body: Your video in {campaign} was approved. Its views now count toward earnings.

rejected.title: Your submission was rejected
rejected.body: Your video in {campaign} was rejected. You can appeal once from the Tasks page.

forfeited.title: Submission earnings forfeited
forfeited.body: Your video in {campaign} is no longer accessible, so its earnings were forfeited.

pending_review.title: Submissions waiting for review: {campaign}
pending_review.body: {count} new submissions are waiting. Without a decision in 72 hours they are approved automatically.

token_expired.title: Reconnect your {platform} account
token_expired.body: Access to your {platform} account{handle} expired or was revoked, so view tracking is paused.

available.title: Earnings ready to withdraw
available.body: {amount} is now Available in your wallet.

paid.title: Payout of {amount} sent
paid.body: The money has been transferred. Arrival time depends on the destination bank or e-wallet.

failed.title: Payout of {amount} failed
failed.body: The balance is back in your wallet. Check your payout account and try again.

cancelled.title: Withdrawal of {amount} cancelled
cancelled.body: The balance is back in Available and can be withdrawn again.

delivered.title: Your reward was delivered
delivered.body: {reward} has been delivered. Details are in the Rewards tab.

cancelled.title: Reward claim cancelled
cancelled.body: The reward balance is back and can be claimed again.

approved.title: Your KYC was approved
approved.body: Your identity is verified. You can now withdraw your balance.

rejected.title: Your KYC was rejected
rejected.body: Fix your details or ID photo and resubmit from the KYC page.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Suspended until {until}. Until then you cannot claim, submit or withdraw.

banned.title: Your account is banned
banned.body: The account was banned for breaking the terms of service. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

warned.title: A warning on your account
warned.body: We found activity that breaks the terms. This is a first warning; further violations can hold earnings or suspend the account. You can appeal in Profile.

issued.title: Invoice {invoice} issued
issued.body: {amount} is due {dueAt}. Pay via QRIS or bank transfer.

paid.title: Payment received
paid.body: We received payment of {amount} for invoice {invoice}.

used.title: {level, select, full {Budget for {campaign} is used up} p80 {80% of the {campaign} budget is used} other {50% of the {campaign} budget is used}}
used.body: {level, select, full {The campaign stopped counting new views. Top up to keep it running.} p80 {Consider a top-up so the campaign does not stop suddenly.} other {Track its performance on the dashboard.}}

projection_low.title: {campaign} is projected below target
projection_low.body: Less than half the budget is expected to be used. Raise the rate, extend the schedule or invite clippers.

rejected.title: Organization verification rejected
rejected.body: Fix the organization details and resubmit from settings.

suspended.title: {org} is suspended
suspended.body: New campaigns cannot be submitted until the suspension is lifted.

link_requested.title: {agency} requests access to {org}
link_requested.body: Approve only if you actually work with this agency.

link_approved.title: {client} approved the agency link
link_approved.body: The client organization now appears in your organization switcher.

requested.title: Refund for {campaign} is being processed
requested.body: Our finance team will transfer {amount} and upload the proof on the billing page.

paid.title: Refund of {amount} transferred
paid.body: The transfer proof is on the billing page.

draft_ready.title: Campaign draft {campaign} is ready for approval
draft_ready.body: Check the summary, then approve and pay so the campaign can be reviewed.

appeal_decided.title: {decision, select, overturned {Appeal accepted} other {Appeal rejected}}
appeal_decided.body: {decision, select, overturned {The sanction was lifted and its effects reversed where possible.} other {The sanction stays in place. The appeal decision is final.}}
